verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a generic observability API/webhook (send-calls) and SDK/CLI that any agent could POST to, plus a named integration for LiveKit voice agents, but there is no documented integration for LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK specifically as the story requests. missing for 10: named LangChain integration, named OpenAI SDK integration, named Vercel AI SDK integration.
